multi_line_comment.comment: -- Reported by Michael Snoyman: UTF-8 encoding a large lazy bytestring -- caused either a segfault or attempt to allocate a negative number -- of bytes.
-- Reported by Pieter Laeremans: attempting to read an incorrectly -- encoded file can result in a crash in the RTS (i.e. not merely an -- exception).
-- Reported by Ian Lynagh: attempting to allocate a sufficiently large -- string (via either Array.new or Text.replicate) could result in an -- integer overflow.
-- Reported by John Millikin: a UTF-8 decode error handler could -- return a bogus substitution character, which we would write without -- checking.
-- Reported by Eric Seidel: we mishandled mapping Chars that fit in a -- single Word16 to Chars that require two.

-- See GitHub issue #301 -- This tests whether the "TEXT take . drop -> unfused" rule is applied to the -- slice function. When the slice function is fused, a new array will be -- constructed that is shorter than the original array. Without fusion the -- array remains unmodified.
-- See Github #559 -- filter/filter fusion rules should apply predicates in the right order.
-- Github #633 -- stimes checked for an `a` to `Int` to `a` roundtrip, but the `a` and `Int` values could represent different integers.
